Proto.Name: IPv6
Proto.Description: Layer 3 Internet Protocol version 6 header. Fixed 40-byte header with a simplified, non-optional layout; extension headers (routing, fragment, hop-by-hop, etc.) are chained via next_header rather than embedded inline.
Fields: payload_len     {16 bits}  = auto (length of payload after this header)
next_header     {8 bits}   = auto (inferred from payload layer, default TCP=6)
